metadata.title: Deoghar Famous MUTTON ATTHE (मटन अट्ठे) @ Oldest Shop l Zero Water Making and Tasting l Dahi Mithai
metadata.description:
In this episode, we explore Deoghar with Harsh, a young local who knows the city and its food culture closely. The video looks at two very different food experiences that exist side by side in this sacred town.

Deoghar is usually known for its temples and vegetarian food traditions. Many people assume that the food here is only sattvik. But everyday eating habits tell a more layered story.

The episode begins at one of the oldest non-veg places in the city. Here, we document the making of a traditional mutton dish called mutton athe, that is prepared without onion or garlic. The entire process is shown in detail. No water is added during cooking. The dish relies on its own juices and slow cooking, following beliefs that have been practiced for generations.

The second part of the video moves to everyday food that locals enjoy. We visited Anil Dahi and Sweet Shop, where fresh curd is eaten with different local sweetmeats. This is followed by a simple morning breakfast experience, showing how people in Deoghar usually begin their day.

Together, these moments offer a more complete picture of Deoghar’s food culture.
